§10.4.6 Printed Buttons and Placeholders

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

forms-printed-buttons-and-placeholders · forms furniture

✅ Normative

The text of a printed button, and the caption of a box reserved for a later stamp or seal, MUST be transcribed as text where it sits, in reading order. A reserved box is not a fill-in and MUST NOT be rendered with [blank].

Fillable PDFs export their widgets into the page: Print, Save, Clear buttons and the notice beside them. Court forms reserve empty boxes — [SEAL], File Stamp Here, COURT USE ONLY — for something to be added by hand later.

Printed thing Rendering
Buttons — Print · Save · Clear in coloured pills at the page foot their text, as text, in reading order — they are printed, so they are kept (never drop)
Reserved boxes — an empty ruled box whose caption says what will go in it the caption as text, nothing else — no blank, since nothing is filled in there (never invent)

✅ Sample — buttons and a seal placeholder

Print, Save, Clear in coloured boxes at the foot, a grey notice beside them, and an empty box captioned [SEAL] at the left of item 5. Item 5 also nests a second row of options under d. The button labels and the [SEAL] caption are plain text.

Accordion rows with chevrons, a See Less toggle, a text input printing its placeholder Enter tracking or barcode numbers, and an FAQs button, all scanned. The browser's own header and footer URL are printed too. Every visible string is kept as text.
